name: remoteedit
description: Browse, edit, and save remote files over SSH/SFTP directly from VS Code.

remoteedit.showStatusBarButton.description: Show the RemoteEdit button in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Show both the icon and the RemoteEdit text.
remoteedit.statusBarButtonStyle.description: Controls how the RemoteEdit status bar button is displayed.

enumDescriptions: Show the RemoteEdit button on the left side of the status bar.
Show the RemoteEdit button on the right side of the status bar.
remoteedit.statusBarButtonAlignment.description: Controls which side of the status bar shows the RemoteEdit button.

remoteedit.statusBarButtonPriority.description: Controls the RemoteEdit status bar button priority. Higher values appear closer to the left within the selected alignment group.

remoteedit.sshReadyTimeout.description: Controls how long RemoteEdit waits, in milliseconds, for an SSH connection to become ready.

remoteedit.sshKeepAliveInterval.description: Controls the SSH keepalive interval, in milliseconds, when Keep connection alive is enabled.

remoteedit.sshKeepAliveCountMax.description: Controls how many unanswered SSH keepalive messages are allowed before the connection is considered lost.

remoteedit.sudoTempDirectory.description: Remote directory used for temporary files when sudo mode saves privileged files. The connected SSH/SFTP user must be able to write to this directory.

remoteedit.restoreSpecialPermissionBits.description: Restore original setuid, setgid, and sticky permission bits after saving existing remote files, when the remote system allows it.
